topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I must say, when I first heard the party wasn't happening, it all felt a bit odd. I mean, celebrations are such a good way to bring everyone together, aren't they? It's just that I had this image in my head of how it would go, and now I'm not sure what to think. I've been trying to focus on something else, maybe diving into a new book or catching up on some quiet activities around the house. It’s just, I keep checking my phone, thinking maybe I missed a message or something. But I guess I'll just have to trust that everything is okay and try to find a different way to enjoy the day.
